_comment: The 'Promote this event' offer. payment_link is the Stripe Payment Link URL; while it is empty the promote page shows the offer and collects interest through /subscribe.php (source 'promote:<slug>') instead of a pay button. The webhook web/promote_webhook.php needs .stripe_webhook_secret one level above the docroot and keeps PROMOTE_DAYS in step with 'days' here. contact_email is shown on the promote page when set.
